_comment: PRIVATE SCREENING (Queen Euphoria p.32-33): Euphoria's abduction, replayed from her inhibitor-free simsense rig. Original paraphrase, never the book's read-aloud; the clues are kept (Burroughs, a Queen). gen.mjs makes raw/, mix.py mixes _work/private-screening/out/private-screening.mp3; copy it to assets/audio/ma-private-screening.mp3.

speech.text: [softly, rehearsing, sorrowful] They came at dawn. [pause] The helicopters... [breath] and when the smoke cleared, the river ran red. [long pause] [sighs, dropping out of character] No. No, that's too much. [quietly] Again.
[whispering to herself, tired] I hate this scene. [beat] Why does it always have to be so... cruel.
[startled, small voice] What was that? [beat] [shaky, louder] Hello? [pause] Is someone out there?
[terrified, barely breathing] Oh no. [whimpers] Oh no, no, no, no...
[delighted, sing-song] There she is. [beat] Even lovelier than on the trid, Euphoria. [softly] Shh. Shh. Don't be scared. [beat] Everything's going to be fine.
[giggles] Listen to me. Fine. [laughs quietly to himself] Nothing is fine, is it? [cooing] Be scared, sweet thing. [whispers] Be very scared.
[intimate whisper, very close] Mister Burroughs wants you taken care of. [beat] And I'll take care of you. [reverent, trembling with joy] I'll make you my Queen.
[screaming, in agony and rage] Get away from her! Get away from—

sfx.text: A simsense headset clicking into place, a rising electronic whine, then a deep sub-bass drop into total silence
An empty dark void, almost silent, a faint distant high ringing tone slowly fading in
A quiet professional recording studio at night, soft equipment hum, silk clothing rustling, slow soft footsteps on thick carpet, a console keypad beeping a few times
Muffled dreamlike memories of disaster: distant helicopter rotors, volleys of rockets, a rioting crowd, rushing flood water, under a mournful low drone
A violent crash of glass and plastic shattering and something heavy landing in the next room
Muffled through a wall: a man screaming, wet flesh tearing, bodies thrown against furniture, then sudden silence
A fast pounding human heartbeat, very close and loud, with ragged frightened breathing
A door slowly opening with a creak, a sticky wet sound on the handle, liquid dripping onto carpet
Close in the dark, the dry rapid clicking and chittering of a huge insect, rhythmic like laughter
A laser sight humming on, then a short burst from a submachine gun indoors
Something heavy dropping from the ceiling onto a man, a crushing impact, a wet spray, a gurgle
A sudden cut to dead silence, then a thin high tinnitus ring slowly fading away
